address: Letten 13, Lauf an der Pegnitz, 91207, Germany
bio: This restaurant has various dining spaces with a charming rustic feel – including lovely cosy alcoves – where diners tuck into seasonal cuisine that is regional but also draws on international influences. Served by friendly and attentive waitstaff, the food is prepared with fresh, good-quality ingredients. Affording views of the verdant surroundings, the terraces in front and to the rear of the building are delightful in summer. This family-run establishment is also ideal for an overnight stay – on the edge of the forest, yet with good transport connections....
